name: TC-LMC-09: switching tabs updates View All destination URL
fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/Homepage/LatestModelsByCategory.cy.js#Homepage - LatestModelsByCategory [ta] TC-LMC-09: switching tabs updates View All destination URL
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-LMC-09
**Title:** Switching tabs updates View All destination URL
**Language:** ta

**Description:**
Switch through each category tab and confirm View All points to the correct listing URL for that tab.

**Expected Result:**
For every tab, View All href matches the expected category listing path from test data.

**Steps:**
1. Open Latest Models by Category
2. Open each category tab
3. Verify View All href for that tab

steps.name: visit /ta
document
its .readyState
assert expected complete to equal complete
get body
scrollIntoView {offset: {top: -140, left: 0}}
assert expected <h2.text-lg.md:text-[21px].font-bold.tracking-[0.8px].mb-4> to exist in the DOM
find button.tab-btn

assert expected [ <button.px-3.tab-padding.tab-btn-size.md:px-4.lg:px-6.py-1.lg:py-1.5.rounded-full.font-bold.text-[12px].cursor-pointer.transition.bg-[#006db7].text-white.tabsBorder.tab-btn>, 4 more... ] to have a length of 5

parameters.value: <button title="3 சக்கர வாகனங்கள்" class="px-3 tab-padding tab-btn-size md:px-4 lg:px-6 py-1 lg:py-1.5 rounded-full font-bold text-[12px] cursor-pointer transition bg-[#006db7] text-white tabsBorder tab-btn">3 சக்கர...</button>
